title: Delegation & entitlement: consent to attributable action
lede: The user consents; token exchange mints a delegated token carrying act={agent}; the gateway validates the chain (actor allow-list, no upstream audience); the policy decides by group entitlement and tier — the directory decides, not the token. Mock only.

nodes.label: Policy: group gate then tier ceiling

edges.label: DENY: not in group / over tier ceiling

steps.title: The user consents
steps.what: One consent: token exchange mints a delegated token — sub is the USER, act={agent} names the actor. Every action traces back to a real human.

steps.title: The gateway validates the chain
steps.what: sub/aud/exp first; then the act chain — act.sub non-empty, the actor on the allow-list, and never an upstream MCP-server audience.

steps.title: The policy reads the directory
steps.what: Group membership and tier are read for EVERY decision — not baked into the token. Flip the membership and the very next call moves.

steps.title: Entitlement decides
steps.what: Not in the required group: DENY regardless of scopes. In the premium group: the tool set and amount ceiling expand — positive least privilege.

steps.title: Attributable dispatch
steps.what: PERMIT dispatches the tool with the full chain: user → act={agent} → decision. Audit gets a chain of custody, not guesswork.
